description: This file defines a `ShareViewController` class responsible for handling shared content in an iOS app extension. It processes shared URLs, text, and images, prepares a draft message, and sends it to the OpenClaw gateway using network sessions. The class includes UI setup, content extraction from extension input items, and communication with external gateways, along with utilities for managing attachments and payloads.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: A view controller for sharing content from iOS system extension, capable of extracting shared URLs, text, images, and sending this data to an external gateway.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initializes the view, sets up UI, and prepares the draft once loaded.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Ensures draft preparation occurs once when the view appears.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures the UI elements: text view, buttons, and layout constraints.

methods.name: prepareDraft
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts shared content, constructs a draft message, and updates UI.

methods.name: handleSendTap
methods.description: Triggers sending of the current draft message.

methods.name: handleCancelTap
methods.description: Completes the extension without sending any content.

methods.name: sendCurrentDraft
methods.description: Sends the draft message and attachments to the gateway, handles success/failure.

methods.name: sendMessageToGateway
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the gateway and transmits the message and attachments.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithLegacyClientId
methods.description: Determines if a retry with a legacy client ID is needed based on the error.

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Displays a status message overlay on the UI.

methods.name: composeDraft
methods.description: Constructs a string draft from shared content payload.

methods.name: sanitizeDraftFragment
methods.description: Sanitizes a text fragment, removing system-specific or irrelevant lines.

methods.name: extractSharedContent
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts shared URL, text, title, and images from extension input items.

methods.name: loadImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads an image attachment, compresses, and encodes it.

methods.name: preferredImageTypeIdentifier
methods.description: Determines preferred image type identifier from provider.

methods.name: normalizedJPEGData
methods.description: Compresses and normalizes image data to a target size.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Loads a URL from an item provider if available.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Loads text content from an item provider.

methods.name: loadURLValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a URL value from an item provider.

methods.name: loadTextValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a text value from an item provider.

methods.name: loadDataValue
methods.description: Loads raw data representation from an item provider.
